preview.changesInvalid: This file could not be shown as a unified diff. Switch to Raw View to see the complete source.
preview.changesGuide: Open Changes View for read-only unified changes in .diff and .patch files. It shows changes by file and hunk with old and new line numbers. Raw View shows the complete source.
preview.tableInvalid: This file could not be shown as a table. Switch to Raw View to see the complete source.
preview.tableGuide: Choose Table View for read-only .csv and .tsv previews. Row numbers and column letters identify cells, and the first row is shown as data. Switch back to Raw View to see the complete source.
preview.markdownUnavailable: This document is too large or complex to render. Open Raw View for the complete source.
preview.invalidJson: Invalid JSON. Open Raw View to see the original text.
preview.textModes: Text previews open in Raw View. Switch to MD View for read-only Markdown in .md files, JSON View for an expandable tree in .json files, or Record View for one record per line in .jsonl files. MD View displays embedded HTML, links, and images as inert content. Copy text always copies the complete original text.
preview.unavailable: This file cannot be previewed. It remains attached.
preview.archiveLimits: ZIP previews list files, folders, and original file sizes. Large archive listings may be unavailable.
preview.pdfLimits: PDF previews are read-only and limited to 24 MiB and 300 pages. Password-protected PDFs are unavailable.
preview.otherLimits: Local folder contents, Office documents, and unlisted formats such as RAR and 7Z cannot be previewed.
preview.eligibility: Attachment eligibility is separate from preview support. Eligible items can stay attached even when a preview is unavailable.
preview.limits: GIFs animate in thumbnails and in the focused viewer. PNG and WebP previews are static. SVGs render as static images without scripts, linked or embedded images, fonts, filters, patterns, or masks. Unreadable, unsupported, invalid, or oversized previews are unavailable. Text previews show the original UTF-8 text.

shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.help: Enter sends in instruction fields; Shift+Enter adds a line. Ctrl+Enter stages Brief → Run only in IssueRun. Ctrl+Shift+Home selects Single Entry; Ctrl+Shift+End selects the last Runner; Ctrl+Shift+PageUp/PageDown selects the adjacent tab without wrapping. Ctrl+1–9 selects by position. Custom assignment keys work in Single Entry instruction fields. Escape cancels capture.
